snippet.title: BLOODLETTER - Steam Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Playable demo out on Steam.
Visit our STEAM page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3493400/BLOODLETTER/

Bloodletter is a medieval deck builder all about using your cards to heal bizarre villagers.
Protect their bodies and minds from the torment of mysterious entities by customising your unique deck and enhancing your dubious healing methods.

Music by Matteo Hoyer:
https://www.instagram.com/matteohoyermusic
